basics.name: Logan Finney
basics.label: Documentary Journalist
basics.summary: Logan Finney is an award-winning reporter who covers politics, elections, and government. He grew up hunting, hiking, and skiing in the Idaho Panhandle and remains forever fascinated by the people, history, and culture of his home state.
